name: GetSiteById
description: Retrieves details of a SharePoint site by its unique Site ID using Microsoft Graph.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Select the Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate the request.

fields.name: SiteId
fields.label: Site ID
fields.description: The unique identifier of the SharePoint site you want to retrieve details for. You can obtain the Site ID from the SharePoint admin center or by using Microsoft Graph API to list sites.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: The result of the site retrieval operation, including site details and any error messages.
